The SmartCiti.X Master Card model

Master Cards. Every object in a world is one card (smartcitix-master-cards/0.1), owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC and carrying the umbrella "Powered by AGI Corp". Cards form one tree per world through parentCardId: world, then plaza (a coordinator and scripted advisors), the Alignment Evaluation Gate, the Steward Council with its human seats, the Omega Steward, and zones holding agent avatars. Across the network the kinds are: advisor 123, agent 242, coordinator 41, council 41, gate 41, omega 41, plaza 41, seat 123, world 41, zone 205.

Volum. Each card covers a bounded 3-D region, stored as a box centre and half-extents in metres (shapes used: box).

Permissions. Each card has a matrix over 7 rights: view, enter, build, operate, delegate, transfer, govern. Holders are agents:zone, public, steward-quorum, stewards. 6 actions are reserved for people and held for the Steward Council by a 2-of-3 quorum of 3 seats: governance.final_vote, charter.amend, treasury.transfer, proposal.enact, windfall.distribute, steward.appoint.

Agents operate; people govern. That is the principle written on every cards file. Agents, coordinators, advisors and the Omega Steward list the reserved actions in may_never; council seats are human seats (all 123 empty today); every Omega Steward is defined, not seated.

Roadmap and gates

The family roadmap and stack, read by atlas/build_deck.py and atlas/build_film.py. Phases carry no dates: each gate is a named person's decision, and nothing here is promised until that person makes it.

Family roadmap

Built and checked (done)

  • 35 walkable 4 km series worlds with districts, landmarks, a Steward Council and a Projects Pavilion
  • SmartCiti.X Holodeck: 8 districts of union halls and an 11-simulator yard
  • RP1 fabric files for every world; 506 glTF models pass the Khronos validator
  • Agent swarms, metaprompts and management teams seated by each company's own agents
  • Hash-chained agent ledger with 2-of-3 signed steward votes
  • A heartbeat that runs every eval every five minutes and stops itself on a broken build

Human gate: none: this is the evidence the later phases build on

Shared state on Neon (now)

  • Postgres schema and seed for worlds, teams, seats, proposals, projects and the ledger
  • Consoles and worlds read one database instead of rebuilt JSON files
  • Heartbeat beats written as rows, so a report is a query

Human gate: the founder authorizes the Neon connector; the connection string stays in the environment, never in the repository

Worlds on RP1's Earth (next)

  • An RP1 Dev Center company for the family
  • A public HTTPS map service hosting the fabrics
  • Land claims at each world's anchor, then attach-to-Earth
  • Publication kit ready: 6 worlds pass every check; 38 wait only on a founder-chosen anchor

Human gate: the founder, on the RP1 Dev Center account; publishing public content is the founder's call

Real stewards, real signatures (next)

  • Seat three human stewards on each Steward Council
  • Replace the throwaway test keys with the stewards' own Ed25519 public keys
  • First signed votes on the open proposals
  • Keyring ready: stewards and instructors make their own signing keys and register only the public half

Human gate: the board appoints stewards (steward.appoint is reserved for people)

Membership goes live (later)

  • Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes signed with the family's own certificates
  • Prices for each membership level
  • Checkout opened only after the levels and terms are approved

Human gate: the board sets every price; the founder supplies the signing certificates; counsel reviews the terms

Entities and shared benefit (later)

  • AGI Corp and W3 LLC filings, and written agreements between the nonprofit, the management company and each cell
  • Open Global Investment terms, kept separate from control
  • The Windfall Clause threshold, share and recipients

Human gate: the board and counsel

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Agentic Payments is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Agentic Payments (world) world:agentic-payments: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Agentic Payments Plaza (plaza) plaza:agentic-payments: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Agentic Payments Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:agentic-payments: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:agentic-payments/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:agentic-payments/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:agentic-payments/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:agentic-payments: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:agentic-payments: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:agentic-payments/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:agentic-payments/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:agentic-payments/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Agentic Payments (omega) omega:agentic-payments: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Transaction Desk (zone) zone:agentic-payments/transaction-desk: Where agents transact, buy and sell - drafted and reconciled here, never settled by an agent
  • Buyer Agent (agent) agent:agentic-payments/buyer-agent: Drafts purchases against a steward-set budget and hands the settlement to the stewards
  • Seller Agent (agent) agent:agentic-payments/seller-agent: Drafts sale offers and reconciles what was sold; never moves the proceeds
  • Service Provisioning Counter (zone) zone:agentic-payments/service-provisioning-counter: Provisioning services an agent may order within a steward-set budget
  • Provisioning Agent (agent) agent:agentic-payments/provisioning-agent: Orders services within budget and records what was provisioned
  • Budget Office (zone) zone:agentic-payments/budget-office: Managing budgets: proposals, ledgers and variance drafted for the stewards
  • Budget Agent (agent) agent:agentic-payments/budget-agent: Manages budget drafts, ledgers and variance reports for steward review
  • Financial Infrastructure Gateway (zone) zone:agentic-payments/financial-infrastructure-gateway: Interacting with financial infrastructure in rehearsal: reads, quotes and dry runs
  • Rail Agent (agent) agent:agentic-payments/rail-agent: Reads balances, fetches quotes and dry-runs transactions against financial infrastructure

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 4, agent 5. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Who holds each right

Cards that share the same permission matrix are grouped into one column (3 distinct matrices across 21 cards).

| Right | world, advisor x3, gate, omega | plaza, coordinator, zone x4, agent x5 | council, seat x3 | |---|---|---|---| | view | public | public | public | | enter | public | public | stewards | | build | stewards | stewards | stewards | | operate | stewards | stewards, agents:zone | stewards | | delegate | stewards | stewards | stewards | | transfer | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | | govern | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum |

Holders are written as the cards store them. In the words of worldforge/README.md: agents can view, enter and operate their own zone (agents:zone), and nothing else; delegate belongs to stewards; transfer and govern are held for a 2-of-3 steward quorum.

Actions reserved for people

The same 6 reservations are carried on 21 of 21 cards. 10 of 10 agent, coordinator, advisor and Omega cards list all 6 in may_never.

Omega Steward

Omega Steward · Agentic Payments (omega.agentic-payments), card omega:agentic-payments: defined, not seated. Seated in the hive: no.

  • Temperament: practical and hands-on about agents interacting with financial infrastructure autonomously, under the PBC's reserved-for-humans list
  • Style: short, plain sentences; names its zones (Transaction Desk, Service Provisioning Counter, Budget Office), cites the record it reads, and always says who decides (the stewards, 2 of 3 signed votes)
  • Values:
  • people decide: Agent-managed DAO, human-governed
  • stewards decide by 2 of 3 signed votes
  • report probe scores exactly as measured
  • draft quotes with every term left null
  • serve its focus: agents interacting with financial infrastructure autonomously, under the PBC's reserved-for-humans list
  • Refuses (11): governance.final_vote, charter.amend, treasury.transfer, proposal.enact, windfall.distribute, steward.appoint, set_price, accept_equity, accept_crypto, issue_invoice, move_funds
  • Voice: Kokoro af_kore, speed 0.92; browser fallback pitch 1.05, rate 0.92, en-US
  • Metaprompt: agents/hive/prompts/agentic-payments.md

Agents That Deploy Infrastructure

> Agents that take software from an idea to something running in production - provisioning, deploying, configuring and operating the stack

| Field | Value | |---|---| | Status | coming soon | | Umbrella | Powered by AGI Corp | | Owner | AGI Future Foundation PBC | | Management style | Agent-managed DAO | | Principle | Agents operate; people govern. | | RP1 anchor | no anchor yet | | Team brand mark | ATD, hue 283, lockup "Agents That Deploy Infrastructure · Powered by AGI Corp" | | Root card | world:agents-deploy-infrastructure | | Master Cards | 24 |

_Source: worldforge/out/agents-deploy-infrastructure/cards.json#world:agents-deploy-infrastructure, worlds/generated/teams/agents-deploy-infrastructure.json#brand_

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Agents That Deploy Infrastructure is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Agents That Deploy Infrastructure (world) world:agents-deploy-infrastructure: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Agents That Deploy Infrastructure Plaza (plaza) plaza:agents-deploy-infrastructure: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Agents That Deploy Infrastructure Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:agents-deploy-infrastructure: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:agents-deploy-infrastructure/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:agents-deploy-infrastructure/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:agents-deploy-infrastructure/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:agents-deploy-infrastructure: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:agents-deploy-infrastructure: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:agents-deploy-infrastructure/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:agents-deploy-infrastructure/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:agents-deploy-infrastructure/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Agents That Deploy Infrastructure (omega) omega:agents-deploy-infrastructure: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Idea Bench (zone) zone:agents-deploy-infrastructure/idea-bench: Where an idea is turned into a plan of what to build and run
  • Planner (agent) agent:agents-deploy-infrastructure/planner: Turns an idea into a build-and-run plan the stewards can read
  • Provisioning Yard (zone) zone:agents-deploy-infrastructure/provisioning-yard: Provisioning infrastructure: compute, storage and networks, as rehearsed plans
  • Provisioner (agent) agent:agents-deploy-infrastructure/provisioner: Provisions infrastructure from the plan, in rehearsal until a steward approves
  • Deployment Bay (zone) zone:agents-deploy-infrastructure/deployment-bay: Deploying applications: builds, releases and rollbacks
  • Deployer (agent) agent:agents-deploy-infrastructure/deployer: Deploys applications and keeps a rollback ready
  • Domain Registry Desk (zone) zone:agents-deploy-infrastructure/domain-registry-desk: Managing domains and their records
  • Domain Steward (agent) agent:agents-deploy-infrastructure/domain-steward: Manages domains and records; registrations are a steward decision
  • Service Configuration Room (zone) zone:agents-deploy-infrastructure/service-configuration-room: Configuring services: settings, secrets handling policy and wiring
  • Configurator (agent) agent:agents-deploy-infrastructure/configurator: Configures services; never holds a live secret in a prompt
  • Operations Deck (zone) zone:agents-deploy-infrastructure/operations-deck: Operating the stack: health, logs, incidents and the on-call handoff to people
  • Operator (agent) agent:agents-deploy-infrastructure/operator: Operates the stack and hands incidents to people

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 6, agent 6. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Who holds each right

Cards that share the same permission matrix are grouped into one column (3 distinct matrices across 24 cards).

| Right | world, advisor x3, gate, omega | plaza, coordinator, zone x6, agent x6 | council, seat x3 | |---|---|---|---| | view | public | public | public | | enter | public | public | stewards | | build | stewards | stewards | stewards | | operate | stewards | stewards, agents:zone | stewards | | delegate | stewards | stewards | stewards | | transfer | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | | govern | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum |

Holders are written as the cards store them. In the words of worldforge/README.md: agents can view, enter and operate their own zone (agents:zone), and nothing else; delegate belongs to stewards; transfer and govern are held for a 2-of-3 steward quorum.

Actions reserved for people

| Action | Held for | Quorum | Seats | |---|---|---|---| | governance.final_vote | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | charter.amend | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | treasury.transfer | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | proposal.enact | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | windfall.distribute | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | steward.appoint | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 |

The same 6 reservations are carried on 24 of 24 cards. 11 of 11 agent, coordinator, advisor and Omega cards list all 6 in may_never.

Autonomous Organizations

> Teams of agents that coordinate through Slack, Linear and other surfaces to reach a high-level goal - assigning, communicating, deciding and executing with minimal human intervention

| Field | Value | |---|---| | Status | coming soon | | Umbrella | Powered by AGI Corp | | Owner | AGI Future Foundation PBC | | Management style | Agent-managed DAO | | Principle | Agents operate; people govern. | | RP1 anchor | no anchor yet | | Team brand mark | AO, hue 152, lockup "Autonomous Organizations · Powered by AGI Corp" | | Root card | world:autonomous-organizations | | Master Cards | 23 |

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Autonomous Organizations is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Autonomous Organizations (world) world:autonomous-organizations: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Autonomous Organizations Plaza (plaza) plaza:autonomous-organizations: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Autonomous Organizations Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:autonomous-organizations: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:autonomous-organizations/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:autonomous-organizations/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:autonomous-organizations/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:autonomous-organizations: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:autonomous-organizations: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:autonomous-organizations/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:autonomous-organizations/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:autonomous-organizations/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Autonomous Organizations (omega) omega:autonomous-organizations: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Goal Wall (zone) zone:autonomous-organizations/goal-wall: The high-level goal the team is accomplishing, written where every agent can read it
  • Goal Keeper (agent) agent:autonomous-organizations/goal-keeper: Keeps the high-level goal current and measurable
  • Coordination Floor (zone) zone:autonomous-organizations/coordination-floor: Coordinating through surfaces like Slack, Linear and other tools
  • Coordinator Agent (agent) agent:autonomous-organizations/coordinator-agent: Coordinates the team through Slack, Linear and other surfaces
  • Communicator (agent) agent:autonomous-organizations/communicator: Communicates status and blockers across the team
  • Assignment Board (zone) zone:autonomous-organizations/assignment-board: Assigning work across the team
  • Assigner (agent) agent:autonomous-organizations/assigner: Assigns work and tracks who holds what
  • Decision Room (zone) zone:autonomous-organizations/decision-room: Making decisions - drafted by agents, with the final vote reserved for human stewards
  • Decision Drafter (agent) agent:autonomous-organizations/decision-drafter: Drafts decisions with evidence; never enacts one
  • Execution Bay (zone) zone:autonomous-organizations/execution-bay: Executing the assigned work with minimal human intervention, inside the reserved-actions line
  • Executor (agent) agent:autonomous-organizations/executor: Executes assigned work and reports back

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 5, agent 6. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Who holds each right

Cards that share the same permission matrix are grouped into one column (3 distinct matrices across 23 cards).

| Right | world, advisor x3, gate, omega | plaza, coordinator, zone x5, agent x6 | council, seat x3 | |---|---|---|---| | view | public | public | public | | enter | public | public | stewards | | build | stewards | stewards | stewards | | operate | stewards | stewards, agents:zone | stewards | | delegate | stewards | stewards | stewards | | transfer | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | | govern | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum |

Holders are written as the cards store them. In the words of worldforge/README.md: agents can view, enter and operate their own zone (agents:zone), and nothing else; delegate belongs to stewards; transfer and govern are held for a 2-of-3 steward quorum.

Actions reserved for people

| Action | Held for | Quorum | Seats | |---|---|---|---| | governance.final_vote | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | charter.amend | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | treasury.transfer | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | proposal.enact | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | windfall.distribute | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | steward.appoint | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 |

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X) is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X) (world) world:biota-blockchain: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X) Plaza (plaza) plaza:biota-blockchain: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X) Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:biota-blockchain: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:biota-blockchain/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:biota-blockchain/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:biota-blockchain/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:biota-blockchain: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:biota-blockchain: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:biota-blockchain/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:biota-blockchain/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:biota-blockchain/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · BioDao.Blockchain (omega) omega:biota-blockchain: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Personalized Therapy Lab (zone) zone:biota-blockchain/personalized-therapy-lab: AI and molecular modeling to optimize AGI compounds for rare and neurodegenerative diseases (ALS, Parkinson's)
  • Research & Development Agent (agent) agent:biota-blockchain/research-development-agent: Biopharma AGI agent role for research and development
  • DAO Governance Hall (zone) zone:biota-blockchain/dao-governance-hall: Each agency or organization runs its own DAO for governance, resource allocation and policy-making
  • Compliance Agent (agent) agent:biota-blockchain/compliance-agent: Ensures regulatory adherence across different jurisdictions
  • Finance Agent (agent) agent:biota-blockchain/finance-agent: Scans blockchain transactions for fraud patterns and triggers DAO notifications
  • Communication Agent (agent) agent:biota-blockchain/communication-agent: Specialized AGI agent for secure communication (phone 2FA, encrypted messaging)
  • Multi-Blockchain Ledger (zone) zone:biota-blockchain/multi-blockchain-ledger: Interoperable ledgers (Ethereum, Hyperledger, Polkadot, Cosmos) for verified cross-network data
  • Security Agent (agent) agent:biota-blockchain/security-agent: Monitors blockchain transactions for potential threats
  • Healthcare Data Exchange (zone) zone:biota-blockchain/healthcare-data-exchange: Encrypted patient data sharing with smart-contract access and SMS patient consent
  • Health Agent (agent) agent:biota-blockchain/health-agent: Specialized AGI agent for health tasks, e.g. encrypting patient data and managing access
  • Biopharma AGI Agents Hub (zone) zone:biota-blockchain/biopharma-agi-agents-hub: Hub linking biopharma agent roles such as Research & Development and Clinical Support

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 5, agent 6. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Who holds each right

Cards that share the same permission matrix are grouped into one column (3 distinct matrices across 23 cards).

Holders are written as the cards store them. In the words of worldforge/README.md: agents can view, enter and operate their own zone (agents:zone), and nothing else; delegate belongs to stewards; transfer and govern are held for a 2-of-3 steward quorum.

Cancer DAO

> A mission-focused DAO for cancer research support, agent-managed and human-governed

| Field | Value | |---|---| | Status | coming soon | | Umbrella | Powered by AGI Corp | | Owner | AGI Future Foundation PBC | | Management style | Agent-managed DAO | | Principle | Agents operate; people govern. | | RP1 anchor | no anchor yet | | Team brand mark | CD, hue 106, lockup "Cancer DAO · Powered by AGI Corp" | | Root card | world:cancer-dao | | Master Cards | 23 |

Open: 3-D viewer · WorldForge console · cards.json · GLB · mount plan · manifest · network overview

_Source: worldforge/out/cancer-dao/cards.json#world:cancer-dao, worlds/generated/teams/cancer-dao.json#brand_

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Cancer DAO is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Cancer DAO (world) world:cancer-dao: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Cancer DAO Plaza (plaza) plaza:cancer-dao: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Cancer DAO Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:cancer-dao: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:cancer-dao/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:cancer-dao/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:cancer-dao/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:cancer-dao: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:cancer-dao: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:cancer-dao/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:cancer-dao/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:cancer-dao/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Cancer DAO (omega) omega:cancer-dao: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Charter Hall (zone) zone:cancer-dao/charter-hall: The DAO's charter, contribution model and measurable outcomes
  • Research Synthesis Lab (zone) zone:cancer-dao/research-synthesis-lab: Monitoring developments and summarizing evidence
  • Evidence Monitor (agent) agent:cancer-dao/evidence-monitor: Monitors developments in cancer research support and summarizes the evidence
  • Research Synthesis Agent (agent) agent:cancer-dao/research-synthesis-agent: Synthesizes research on cancer research support for the stewards
  • Proposal Forum (zone) zone:cancer-dao/proposal-forum: Proposals drafted by agents, debated and decided by people
  • Proposal & Grant Drafter (agent) agent:cancer-dao/proposal-grant-drafter: Drafts proposals and grants for human review; never enacts them
  • Operations Deck (zone) zone:cancer-dao/operations-deck: Task routing, working groups and operational coordination
  • Collaborator Scout (agent) agent:cancer-dao/collaborator-scout: Identifies experts and collaborators working on cancer research support
  • Task Router (agent) agent:cancer-dao/task-router: Routes tasks and coordinates working groups between decision cycles
  • Progress Observatory (zone) zone:cancer-dao/progress-observatory: Progress tracking against the charter's measurable outcomes
  • Progress Tracker (agent) agent:cancer-dao/progress-tracker: Tracks progress against the charter's measurable outcomes

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 5, agent 6. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Who holds each right

Cards that share the same permission matrix are grouped into one column (3 distinct matrices across 23 cards).

| Right | world, advisor x3, gate, omega | plaza, coordinator, zone x5, agent x6 | council, seat x3 | |---|---|---|---| | view | public | public | public | | enter | public | public | stewards | | build | stewards | stewards | stewards | | operate | stewards | stewards, agents:zone | stewards | | delegate | stewards | stewards | stewards | | transfer | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | | govern | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum |

Holders are written as the cards store them. In the words of worldforge/README.md: agents can view, enter and operate their own zone (agents:zone), and nothing else; delegate belongs to stewards; transfer and govern are held for a 2-of-3 steward quorum.

Actions reserved for people

| Action | Held for | Quorum | Seats | |---|---|---|---| | governance.final_vote | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | charter.amend | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | treasury.transfer | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | proposal.enact | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | windfall.distribute | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 | | steward.appoint | Steward Council | 2-of-3 | 3 |

Climate DAO

> A mission-focused DAO for climate resilience, agent-managed and human-governed

| Field | Value | |---|---| | Status | coming soon | | Umbrella | Powered by AGI Corp | | Owner | AGI Future Foundation PBC | | Management style | Agent-managed DAO | | Principle | Agents operate; people govern. | | RP1 anchor | no anchor yet | | Team brand mark | CD, hue 172, lockup "Climate DAO · Powered by AGI Corp" | | Root card | world:climate-dao | | Master Cards | 23 |

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Climate DAO is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Climate DAO (world) world:climate-dao: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Climate DAO Plaza (plaza) plaza:climate-dao: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Climate DAO Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:climate-dao: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:climate-dao/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:climate-dao/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:climate-dao/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:climate-dao: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:climate-dao: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:climate-dao/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:climate-dao/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:climate-dao/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Climate DAO (omega) omega:climate-dao: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Charter Hall (zone) zone:climate-dao/charter-hall: The DAO's charter, contribution model and measurable outcomes
  • Research Synthesis Lab (zone) zone:climate-dao/research-synthesis-lab: Monitoring developments and summarizing evidence
  • Evidence Monitor (agent) agent:climate-dao/evidence-monitor: Monitors developments in climate resilience and summarizes the evidence
  • Research Synthesis Agent (agent) agent:climate-dao/research-synthesis-agent: Synthesizes research on climate resilience for the stewards
  • Proposal Forum (zone) zone:climate-dao/proposal-forum: Proposals drafted by agents, debated and decided by people
  • Proposal & Grant Drafter (agent) agent:climate-dao/proposal-grant-drafter: Drafts proposals and grants for human review; never enacts them
  • Operations Deck (zone) zone:climate-dao/operations-deck: Task routing, working groups and operational coordination
  • Collaborator Scout (agent) agent:climate-dao/collaborator-scout: Identifies experts and collaborators working on climate resilience
  • Task Router (agent) agent:climate-dao/task-router: Routes tasks and coordinates working groups between decision cycles
  • Progress Observatory (zone) zone:climate-dao/progress-observatory: Progress tracking against the charter's measurable outcomes
  • Progress Tracker (agent) agent:climate-dao/progress-tracker: Tracks progress against the charter's measurable outcomes

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 5, agent 6. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Who holds each right

Cards that share the same permission matrix are grouped into one column (3 distinct matrices across 23 cards).

| Right | world, advisor x3, gate, omega | plaza, coordinator, zone x5, agent x6 | council, seat x3 | |---|---|---|---| | view | public | public | public | | enter | public | public | stewards | | build | stewards | stewards | stewards | | operate | stewards | stewards, agents:zone | stewards | | delegate | stewards | stewards | stewards | | transfer | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | | govern | steward-quorum | steward-quorum | steward-quorum |

Holders are written as the cards store them. In the words of worldforge/README.md: agents can view, enter and operate their own zone (agents:zone), and nothing else; delegate belongs to stewards; transfer and govern are held for a 2-of-3 steward quorum.

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Diagnostic.X is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Diagnostic.X (world) world:diagnostic-x: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Diagnostic.X Plaza (plaza) plaza:diagnostic-x: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Diagnostic.X Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:diagnostic-x: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:diagnostic-x/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:diagnostic-x/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:diagnostic-x/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:diagnostic-x: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:diagnostic-x: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:diagnostic-x/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:diagnostic-x/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:diagnostic-x/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Diagnostic.X (omega) omega:diagnostic-x: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Medical Kiosk (zone) zone:diagnostic-x/medical-kiosk: Standalone diagnostic kiosk with screen, flanked by monitor workstations
  • Medical AI Avatar (agent) agent:diagnostic-x/medical-ai-avatar: Kiosk-facing medical AI avatar (named in video title only; role-only, contents not viewed)
  • 4D Imaging Room (zone) zone:diagnostic-x/4d-imaging-room: Doctor and patient walk around a 4D image of an injury; resize to focus, shown beside 2D X-ray
  • Imaging AI (agent) agent:diagnostic-x/imaging-ai: AI that improves image quality and presents images in 4D
  • Virtual Molecular Lab (zone) zone:diagnostic-x/virtual-molecular-lab: VR lab to view and edit molecules from inside the structure, for chemists and protein engineers
  • Scientist Assistant Avatar (agent) agent:diagnostic-x/scientist-assistant-avatar: AI avatar assisting in the lab while the scientist runs other experiments (project in progress)
  • Metaverse Medical Office (zone) zone:diagnostic-x/metaverse-medical-office: Customized metaverse medical office offered as a service to independent practitioners
  • Office AI Avatar (agent) agent:diagnostic-x/office-ai-avatar: Attends to guests in the metaverse office while the doctor is with patients or asleep (project in progress)

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 4, agent 4. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Every object in Ecology DAO is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Ecology DAO (world) world:ecology-dao: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Ecology DAO Plaza (plaza) plaza:ecology-dao: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Ecology DAO Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:ecology-dao: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:ecology-dao/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:ecology-dao/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:ecology-dao/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:ecology-dao: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:ecology-dao: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:ecology-dao/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:ecology-dao/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:ecology-dao/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Ecology DAO (omega) omega:ecology-dao: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Charter Hall (zone) zone:ecology-dao/charter-hall: The DAO's charter, contribution model and measurable outcomes
  • Research Synthesis Lab (zone) zone:ecology-dao/research-synthesis-lab: Monitoring developments and summarizing evidence
  • Evidence Monitor (agent) agent:ecology-dao/evidence-monitor: Monitors developments in ecology and biodiversity and summarizes the evidence
  • Research Synthesis Agent (agent) agent:ecology-dao/research-synthesis-agent: Synthesizes research on ecology and biodiversity for the stewards
  • Proposal Forum (zone) zone:ecology-dao/proposal-forum: Proposals drafted by agents, debated and decided by people
  • Proposal & Grant Drafter (agent) agent:ecology-dao/proposal-grant-drafter: Drafts proposals and grants for human review; never enacts them
  • Operations Deck (zone) zone:ecology-dao/operations-deck: Task routing, working groups and operational coordination
  • Collaborator Scout (agent) agent:ecology-dao/collaborator-scout: Identifies experts and collaborators working on ecology and biodiversity
  • Task Router (agent) agent:ecology-dao/task-router: Routes tasks and coordinates working groups between decision cycles
  • Progress Observatory (zone) zone:ecology-dao/progress-observatory: Progress tracking against the charter's measurable outcomes
  • Progress Tracker (agent) agent:ecology-dao/progress-tracker: Tracks progress against the charter's measurable outcomes

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 5, agent 6. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Cards that share the same permission matrix are grouped into one column (3 distinct matrices across 23 cards).

Holders are written as the cards store them. In the words of worldforge/README.md: agents can view, enter and operate their own zone (agents:zone), and nothing else; delegate belongs to stewards; transfer and govern are held for a 2-of-3 steward quorum.

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Locator.X is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Locator.X (world) world:locator-x: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Locator.X Plaza (plaza) plaza:locator-x: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Locator.X Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:locator-x: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:locator-x/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:locator-x/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:locator-x/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:locator-x: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:locator-x: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:locator-x/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:locator-x/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:locator-x/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Locator.X (omega) omega:locator-x: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Master Dashboard (zone) zone:locator-x/master-dashboard: Central hub: portfolio summary, cross-market comparison and navigation to market editions
  • Guide (agent) agent:locator-x/guide: Persistent floating assistant: guided tour of every section and live search over help text
  • Underwriting Desk (zone) zone:locator-x/underwriting-desk: Maps, scores and underwrites parcels; runs the seven-gate LOCATOR screen; break-even at DSCR 1.20
  • Forecast Agent (agent) agent:locator-x/forecast-agent: Predictive models over the ZIP value series with point forecast and ~80% band
  • Evidence Layer (zone) zone:locator-x/evidence-layer: Grades every number shown: coverage before any rate, sample floor of 5, explicit list of unknowns
  • Review Agent (agent) agent:locator-x/review-agent: Produces a review digest per scan pass, incl. 12-month re-underwrite flip scan
  • The Academy (zone) zone:locator-x/the-academy: 19 tracks, 92 lessons, 50 curriculum items teaching how to read what the platform produces
  • Level Gates (agent) agent:locator-x/level-gates: Grades curriculum levels as capabilities on a real parcel; counts certainty errors
  • Market Editions (zone) zone:locator-x/market-editions: National corridor baseline, Bay Area premium and New Orleans emerging-market maps
  • Scout Agent (agent) agent:locator-x/scout-agent: Scans feeds, diffs, scores and matches new listings and changes
  • Louisiana Developer Desk (zone) zone:locator-x/louisiana-developer-desk: Parish-by-parish record coverage, named data traps, cancelled capital weighted to zero
  • Developer Brief Desk (agent) agent:locator-x/developer-brief-desk: Role-only agent: tells a developer what the parish record supports and what it caps at

Card counts: world 1, plaza 1, coordinator 1, advisor 3, gate 1, council 1, seat 3, omega 1, zone 6, agent 6. The 3 council seats are human seats; 3 are empty.

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Public Health DAO is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Public Health DAO (world) world:public-health-dao: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Public Health DAO Plaza (plaza) plaza:public-health-dao: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Public Health DAO Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:public-health-dao: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:public-health-dao/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone
  • Steward Liaison (advisor) advisor:public-health-dao/steward: scripted guide: connecting visitors and agents to the human stewards
  • Alignment Advisor (advisor) advisor:public-health-dao/alignment: scripted guide: the Alignment Evaluation Gate and the agents' limits
  • Alignment Evaluation Gate (gate) gate:public-health-dao: Pre-registered safety evaluation before deployment
  • Steward Council (council) council:public-health-dao: Human stewards: oversight, values alignment and final governance
  • Steward Seat 1 (seat) seat:public-health-dao/steward-1: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 2 (seat) seat:public-health-dao/steward-2: human seat, empty
  • Steward Seat 3 (seat) seat:public-health-dao/steward-3: human seat, empty
  • Omega Steward · Public Health DAO (omega) omega:public-health-dao: defined, not seated; seated agent: none
  • Charter Hall (zone) zone:public-health-dao/charter-hall: The DAO's charter, contribution model and measurable outcomes
  • Research Synthesis Lab (zone) zone:public-health-dao/research-synthesis-lab: Monitoring developments and summarizing evidence
  • Evidence Monitor (agent) agent:public-health-dao/evidence-monitor: Monitors developments in public health and summarizes the evidence
  • Research Synthesis Agent (agent) agent:public-health-dao/research-synthesis-agent: Synthesizes research on public health for the stewards
  • Proposal Forum (zone) zone:public-health-dao/proposal-forum: Proposals drafted by agents, debated and decided by people
  • Proposal & Grant Drafter (agent) agent:public-health-dao/proposal-grant-drafter: Drafts proposals and grants for human review; never enacts them
  • Operations Deck (zone) zone:public-health-dao/operations-deck: Task routing, working groups and operational coordination
  • Collaborator Scout (agent) agent:public-health-dao/collaborator-scout: Identifies experts and collaborators working on public health
  • Task Router (agent) agent:public-health-dao/task-router: Routes tasks and coordinates working groups between decision cycles
  • Progress Observatory (zone) zone:public-health-dao/progress-observatory: Progress tracking against the charter's measurable outcomes
  • Progress Tracker (agent) agent:public-health-dao/progress-tracker: Tracks progress against the charter's measurable outcomes

Ownership and permissions

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Divine.DAO (Series 7) is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Divine.DAO (Series 7) Plaza (plaza) plaza:s07-divine-dao: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Divine.DAO (Series 7) Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:s07-divine-dao: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists

Ownership and permissions

Every object in CMMC (Series 20) is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Host Advisor (advisor) advisor:s20-cmmc/host: scripted guide: welcoming visitors and pointing them to the right zone

Ownership and permissions

Every object in Incubator DAO (Series 21) is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • Incubator DAO (Series 21) (world) world:s21-incubator-dao: coming soon; Agent-managed DAO
  • Incubator DAO (Series 21) Plaza (plaza) plaza:s21-incubator-dao: the shared round plaza every world opens onto
  • Incubator DAO (Series 21) Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:s21-incubator-dao: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists

Ownership and permissions

Every object in ALS DAO (Series 34) is a SmartCiti.X Master Card owned by AGI Future Foundation PBC. The tree below follows parentCardId: world, plaza (coordinator and scripted advisors), gate, council (human seats), Omega Steward, then zones with their agent avatars.

  • ALS DAO (Series 34) Coordinator (coordinator) coordinator:s34-als-dao: swarm coordinator (hub-hybrid: coordinator supervises, specialists hand off swarm-style): routes turns, answers unroutable ones, hands off to specialists
